shared_elements: low-relief incised human body with ornament/pectoral
justification: Both depict a human figure rendered in shallow incised relief with a tall elaborated headdress and worn ornaments, and both employ a circular disc motif (as a chest emblem in A, as the framing form and border in B). But A is a frontal, monolithic, largely static body covered with isolated symbols, while B shows an active seated/crouching figure with a feathered or winged arm, a second face confronting it, and an encircling openwork band — a narrative composition with no counterpart in A.
